## What's Changed
* Generate full conformance test summaries by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2476
* refactor(specmatic): use coverage ops with stable ctrf test identity by @jaydeepk in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2467
* Treat missing WSDL SOAP addresses like host-only addresses by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2480
* Add WSDL attributeGroup support by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2481
* Add SOAP response header support for WSDL by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2482
* [SECURITY] Update dependency io.netty:netty-codec-http to v4.2.13.Final by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2478
* Update dependency io.netty:netty-codec-http2 to v4.2.13.Final by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2483
* Refactor backward compatibility for performance and correctness by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2485
* Update Gradle to v8.14.5 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2487
* refactor: delete the old unused ctrf report generation method by @yogeshnikam671 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2490
* Update plugin io.specmatic.gradle to v0.15.8 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2468
* [SECURITY] Update dependency org.thymeleaf:thymeleaf to v3.1.5.RELEASE by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2479
* Update dependency joda-time:joda-time to v2.14.2 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2455
* chore: pass before and after fixture execution details to CtrfTestMetadata in ctrf report by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2484
* Add WSDL support for wildcards, inherited attributes, and simpleContent extensions by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2491
* Support form-exploded object query params with additionalProperties by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2492
* Improve reporting for dropped or modified request content-type by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2488


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.45.1...2.46.0
